name: lane_send
description: Send a supplement to a lane you currently lead (attached or summary, already started). It is appended to the lane's conversation as an agent-authored message; the brief and its revision stay unchanged, so earlier Ready reports and close evidence remain valid. Never use it to change objectives or acceptance criteria: use lane_revise_brief. Only the lane's current lane-external root Orchestrator lead may call this; a detached lane or an old lead is rejected. Use the observed management and brief revisions (lane_list) and a unique operation_id; an identical retry replays the original result. Saved durably before it is delivered; it is not read-confirmation and is never user input or permission.
